summary: Saint Louis County, MN steel tower of about 90 ft, maintained by the USFS per a 1934 survey note; dismantled and moved in June 1964; new site not named in sources.

facts.design: Steel tower, 90 ft high, per 1934 survey station description
facts.status_note: Dismantled and moved in June 1964; no source found names the new location or says whether it stands

events.note: Survey station description of a 90-ft steel tower maintained by the USFS; station disk set in bedrock at the center of the tower base
Coast and Geodetic Survey recovery note: station found in good condition, as described
Tower dismantled and moved to another location; destination not named in sources

evidence.supports: station lies just south of Ely, at the center of the tower base
evidence.quote: JUST SOUTH OF ELY AND APPROXIMATELY AT CENTER OF BASE OF ELY FIRE LOOKOUT TOWER.
MARKED BY STANDARD STATION DISK IN BEDROCK

evidence.supports: directions run south on County Route 21 from Ely
evidence.quote: GO S ON CENTRAL ST. (COUNTY ROUTE 21)

evidence.supports: a side road leads off County Route 21
evidence.quote: FOR 0.95 MILE TO SIDE ROAD LEFT

evidence.supports: a short gravel road off the side road leads to the tower
evidence.quote: TURN LEFT AND GO E ON GRAVEL ROAD FOR 0.15 MILE TO LOOKOUT TOWER ON LEFT
TOWER IS 90 FEET HIGH, CONSTRUCTED OF STEEL

evidence.supports: maintained by the United States Forest Service
evidence.quote: MAINTAINED BY THE UNITED STATES FOREST SERVICE.

evidence.supports: 90-ft steel tower maintained by the USFS, per 1934 survey notes
evidence.quote: Tower is 90 feet high, constructed of steel

evidence.supports: 1959 recovery found the marker in good condition
evidence.quote: STATION RECOVERED AS DESCRIBED AND FOUND TO BE IN GOOD CONDITION.

mantled and moved to another location.

corrections.why: The stored value is the first line of the 1964 entry on the Forest Lookouts page, not an agency name. The 1934 survey description says the Forest Service maintained the tower.

notes_for_editor: The brief's agency value 'June 1964:' is a parse error and is corrected above. Only one local page and the A-Z list speak to Ely; two searches did not find where the tower was moved. Height 90 ft from the 1934 survey note, converted to 27.4 m. No staffing or fire records were found, so none are written.
